excluded_symbols.SPY: User explicitly limited this first experiment to QQQ.

strategy.name: intraday_dynamic_sma200_asymmetric_threshold_with_optional_corrections
strategy.description: SMA200 uses completed history through the prior close to solve the exact next-session price at which the provisional current SMA200 reaches each a/b buffer. Start flat. When flat and the prior completed close is at or below the completed buy boundary, place the ordinary upward trigger; when long, keep the ordinary downward trigger active. Optionally also place a correction buy c% above the last effective sell fill or a correction sell d% below the last effective buy fill, with c=d in this experiment. The first eligible trigger in the current position direction executes and the position becomes fully invested or fully flat.
strategy.buy_rule: Flat ordinary entry: prior_close <= prior_sma200*(1+b/100), then buy if current regular-session price reaches P where P=(1+b/100)*(sum of prior 199 closes + P)/200. If correction mode is enabled and a prior sell exists, also buy at last effective sell fill*(1+c/100); execute the lower upward trigger first.
strategy.sell_rule: While long, sell if current regular-session price reaches downward P where P=(1-a/100)*(sum of prior 199 closes + P)/200. If correction mode is enabled, also sell at last effective buy fill*(1-d/100); execute the higher downward trigger first.
strategy.signal_time: All trigger eligibility and prices are known before each regular session using only completed closes through the preceding session plus prior effective account fills.
strategy.execution_time: If the regular-session Open has already crossed a predeclared trigger, fill at Open; otherwise fill at the exact theoretical trigger when the adjusted regular-session OHLC touches it. Apply the configured adverse cost to the raw fill. At most one fill per session.
strategy.positioning: long-only; start with 100,000 USD cash; every buy invests all cash and every sell liquidates all shares; fractional shares; no financing; cash earns zero

parameters.requested_interval: 2021-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive; normalized to available QQQ sessions

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at the 2021-01-04 regular-session Open, including the configured one-sided entry cost, and hold through the 2025-12-31 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the accepted v3 navigation, visible-window axes, performance controls, rebase and DCA interactions. Add experiment-specific three-panel CAGR heatmaps and dynamic SMA200/correction overlays only in the report assembler.

research.hypothesis: Predeclared intraday SMA200 thresholds remove the avoidable next-open delay from the prior close-confirmed strategy, while optional symmetric 5% or 10% correction exits and re-entries may reduce the cost of large false breaks without making the a/b surface depend on an isolated optimum.
research.primary_metric: 5 bps CAGR interpreted jointly with Sharpe, maximum drawdown, order count, exposure, surface connectedness, neighborhood stability and the common-start QQQ Buy & Hold benchmark; retain 0 bps for cost sensitivity.
research.selection_rule: For each correction scenario independently, exhaustively evaluate the full 161x161 a/b grid. Report the mechanical global CAGR maximum, but select the stable representative only from the largest four-neighbor component of top-decile CAGR cells by maximizing the 3x3 neighborhood median minus half its standard deviation; do not promote a boundary-truncated or isolated maximum.
research.validation_plan: The compiled exhaustive ledger must match the direct reference ledger on golden cases. For every correction scenario and cost block, formally verify the global maximum, stable representative and a=b=0 anchor with PyBroker and the independent daily ledger. Any future use must freeze candidates before a separate 2026+ locked or walk-forward experiment.
research.promotion_criteria: No promotion from this run. It may only nominate candidates if engineering gates pass, stable regions are not isolated, 5 bps behavior remains economically coherent, and a later predeclared out-of-sample experiment is useful.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject or redesign if trigger prices use current-bar data before execution, daily OHLC requires an unresolvable second same-day fill, screening and formal metrics differ, PyBroker and the independent ledger diverge, results rely on no-trade artifacts or isolated/boundary-truncated winners, or 5 bps costs destroy the candidate region.
